_README: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, as the mFI-5 and Kraiss sVQI-FS
score items define it: SNOMED 13645005 -> OMOP 255573 plus descendants.
DELIBERATELY NOT the [DVI] VA-FI Chronic lung disease cohort (1797958).
That cohort is a faithful VA Frailty Index deficit (Cheng et al., J Gerontol
A 2021) and correctly spans asthma, interstitial lung disease, chronic
bronchitis and bronchiectasis as one organ-system category. Neither the
mFI-5 nor the sVQI-FS COPD item means that; scoring a patient positive for
asthma would not reproduce either published instrument.

PrimaryCriteriaLimit / QualifiedLimit / ExpressionLimit are all "All" and EndStrategy is StartDate+0, unlike the [DVI] VA-FI cohorts (1797948-1797977) which are "First". A first-ever-only cohort cannot answer a lookback-window question.
